concepts.name: The Olive Sanctuary
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one ORIGINAL finished illustration for the BACK of an Olivia Arcana tarot card, shown flat and straight-on, full-frame portrait 7:12 proportion, high resolution. The three attached images are STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCES ONLY (Star, Moon, High Priestess); do not reproduce their scenes, text or identities. Match their rich dark lapis blue, warm carved ivory, sculpted blue-on-blue details, tiny deliberate muted gold accents, tactile mineral grain and coherent shallow bas-relief. The result must feel part of this exact deck. Pictorial craft, believable contours, elegantly simplified large shapes, rich local detail. Broad dark resting spaces; quiet, diffuse illumination that describes carved depth without a glossy 3D-render look. Subtle narrow softly worn blue perimeter, no added thick frame. Show ONLY the full rectangular card-back artwork: no room, mockup, table, surrounding margin, hands, title, number, lettering, watermark or central corporate logo. Design for a two-ended playing-card back with an intentional 180-degree rotational relationship. The symmetry is in the design; natural detail within each half should be organic, never a radial kaleidoscope. Avoid ornate gold picture frames, scattered occult icons, thick gold outlines, random ornament, gratuitous stars, fake scratches covering everything, plastic gold, excessive bevels, rainbow iridescence.
COMPOSITION 01 — THE OLIVE SANCTUARY. The artwork is a small sculpted sanctuary: exactly two slender ivory herons, one in the upper-left half and its 180-degree counterpart in the lower-right half, gently curved long necks directed toward a still deep-blue oval pool at centre. Each heron is anatomically credible with one head, elegant fine beak, correctly attached feet, softly overlapping carved feathers. Their poised silhouettes and the curving shore hold the composition together. Lapis olive trees rise around the birds and along the margins, their connected tapering branches and slender lanceolate leaves thoughtfully arranged to frame the pool. Most leaves and landscape are shallow blue stone relief, only several olive fruit and a delicate interrupted waterline are muted gold. Sculptural ivory birds occupy about a quarter of the image, the dark reflective pool and lapis breathing space remain dominant. Fine reeds and just a few water ripples. The olive branches are living botanical forms inside the scene. Mood: intimate, serene, mysterious. No moon disc, no sunburst, no surrounding ornamental wreath. The central pool has no symbol or medallion.

COMPOSITION 02 — THE VEILED THRESHOLD. COMPOSITION 05 — THE GARDEN OF WATER. A mysterious shallow lapis garden seen FROM DIRECTLY ABOVE, composed as two rotationally opposed halves. Two broad winding blue streams flow through carved terraces toward one small still elongated oval basin at the centre. A restrained thin gold current runs inside each stream, recalling the gold path on the reference Moon card. Three or four broad, softly stepped terrace shapes in each half define the whole spatial rhythm; a few naturally connected olive branches curl along the margins, blue relief leaves with a few ivory undersides. The image reads first as a beautifully composed landscape in stone, then reveals delicate water ripples and olive fruit on closer inspection. An enigmatic aerial garden, tactile and spatial, with the same sculptural reality as the reference deck.
